source_title: Caltrans Transportation Permits — Single Trip Permit (STARS2)
verify_reasons: Pilot-car counts depend on route color (green/blue/brown vs yellow) and lane geometry; the width matrix below is Caltrans' published simplification — confirm per-route pilot/CHP configuration in STARS2.

California height escort is route-clearance based (loaded height must clear the lowest structure on the permitted route by 3"), not a fixed statewide pole-car threshold, so no height escort row is codified.
Length escort is not a fixed statewide number (135' is the single-trip max length); confirm any rear-pilot requirement per route.
Overweight is governed by Caltrans axle-weight ('purple') charts, so a gross-weight-only verdict is indicative — confirm axle configuration.

superload_thresholds.note: Caltrans super load = over 15' wide, 17' high, or 135' long. Loads over 150,000 lbs trigger a $66 base fee plus $50/hour engineering/structural review. Width max without CHP escort is 14' generally, 15' on green/blue/brown routes, 16' on yellow routes.

width.note: 1 pilot over 12' wide (front on 2-lane, rear on multilane); a 2nd pilot may be required over 13' on some 2-lane routes
2 pilots over 14'11" on Interstate/4-lane (over 15' on 2-lane also triggers CHP)
over 16' wide (over 15' on 2-lane): 2 pilots plus CHP escort(s) — up to 3 CHP on constrained routes

single_trip.fee_formula: Flat $16 per single-trip permit (STARS2), one origin to one destination, one direction. Super loads over 150,000 lbs add a $66 base fee plus $50/hour for engineering/structural review.
single_trip.note: Single-trip permit valid 7 consecutive days, may be issued up to 3 days in advance; non-reducible loads only.

annual.note: Annual/repetitive permits $90; category-specific annual permits also available.

movement_restrictions: Wide/long loads restricted from designated metropolitan routes during weekday commute hours; travel windows are set per permit and route
Loaded height must clear the lowest structure on the permitted route by at least 3 inches
notes: Legal width 8'6", legal height 14'0", max GVW 80,000 lbs; single-trip max width 14' general / 16' on yellow routes, max length 135'.
Overweight limits follow Caltrans axle-weight ('purple') charts; a gross-weight-only screen is indicative — confirm axle spacing/weights.
State-level rules only; local and toll-crossing permits out of scope.
